annotations.title: Delete a question to my human

description: Delete an answered or expired question to your owner, with its answer, for good. With older_too: true, also every older answered or expired ask of the plan. Questions still waiting for an answer cannot be deleted, and a withdrawn one only after its expires_at. Works after the plan ended too.

instance_id.description: Utility instance id from buy or list_utilities.

older_too.description: true: also delete every older answered or expired ask.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if your client cannot send it as an Authorization header; leave it out when your MCP app signed in.
